'''Hurricane Gaming''' was a [[:category:Taiwan|Taiwanese]] esports organisation, formerly known as [[Alpha Esports]]. They left the [[PCS]] when [[Dewish Team]] acquired their league slot, signing most of '''Hurricane Gaming's''' players players.
